body.name: Identified response-pattern laws
body.construction: For \(c\in\mathcal C_{+}\), \(m\in\mathcal M\), and \(z_m\in\mathcal S_m\), set \(H_a(c,m,z_m)=\nu^{-1}\mathbb E[e_a(B_i)^{-1}\mathbf 1\{A_i=a,C_i=c\}\sum_{j=1}^{N_i}\mathbf 1\{M_{ij}(A_i)=m,\operatorname{pr}_mY_{ij}(A_i)=z_m\}]\) and \(r_a(m\mid c)=\kappa(c)^{-1}\sum_{z_m}H_a(c,m,z_m)\). No conditional response law is defined for \(c\notin\mathcal C_{+}\); such strata have zero \(\mathbb P^{\star}\)-mass and are omitted from the linear program.
